title: DAY 1 — MEANING AND IMPORTANCE OF TEAMWORK

options: People cooperating to achieve a common goal
Offering appropriate help to a busy colleague
Ignoring problems outside your assigned duties

questions.prompt: Does teamwork require everyone to agree on every issue?
options: Yes, staff must always share opinions

questions.prompt: A colleague is struggling during a busy shift. What should you do?
options: Ignore them because it is their duty
Offer appropriate assistance while managing your duties
